cases.name: multi_slice
cases.intended_stress: multiple independently coded slices per macroblock row with predictor resets, non-unit leading macroblock addresses, motion, and residuals
cases.expected_current_boundary: general slice streaming and arbitrary legal slice endpoints

cases.name: dense_residual
cases.intended_stress: dense texture, dense coefficient traffic, and ordinary encoder quantiser decisions
cases.expected_current_boundary: picture-wide residual descriptor and coefficient-event caps

cases.name: mixed_macroblocks
cases.intended_stress: ordinary encoder selection among intra, predicted, skipped, and residual macroblocks
cases.expected_current_boundary: intra-coded macroblocks within P and B pictures

cases.name: long_gop
cases.intended_stress: long GOP playback, repeated reference rotation, B reordering, and sequence continuation
cases.expected_current_boundary: long-stream ownership, publication, and soak validation
